requirement.statement: The system SHALL normalize common low-risk shell command shapes before deciding that bash syntax requires human approval.

case.given: A bash command contains multiple top-level lines that each parse as supported command segments
case.when: The local permission evaluator parses the command
case.then: The evaluator SHALL treat the newline as a segment boundary and apply existing per-segment rules

case.given: A bash command invokes python through stdin heredoc with or without an explicit dash argument
case.when: The heredoc prefix is otherwise supported
case.then: The evaluator SHALL normalize the command to a python stdin segment such as `python3 -`
